stages.title: Reliable Platform
stages.purpose: Close the remaining model-switch and lifecycle reliability gaps before expanding the control plane.
stages.successCriteria: Cold starts, model changes, lifecycle transitions and recovery paths fail clearly and recover predictably.

stages.title: Operational Control Plane
stages.purpose: Complete dependable distribution, durable operations and shared update orchestration.
stages.successCriteria: Long-running work, updates, release evidence and lifecycle controls share authoritative state and recovery paths.

stages.title: Project Centre and Product UX
stages.purpose: Introduce stable project identity and complete the main product-management surfaces.
stages.successCriteria: Projects, chats, tasks, reports and product diagnostics remain correctly associated and recoverable.

stages.title: Trust and Data Boundaries
stages.purpose: Add shared trust contracts, scoped data access and secure access controls.
stages.successCriteria: Integrations, projects, memories, indexing and remote clients obey explicit permissions and isolation rules.

stages.title: Version 1.0 Stable
stages.purpose: Deliver a supported Windows distribution for users who should not need a native build toolchain.
stages.successCriteria: Guided installation, verified runtime packages, release integrity and lifecycle recovery pass the stable release matrix.

stages.title: Post-v1.0 Inference Fabric
stages.purpose: Generalise the current llama.cpp integration into a typed multi-backend runtime platform.
stages.successCriteria: Owned and external runtimes use common capability, identity, lifecycle and recovery contracts.

stages.title: Post-v1.0 Optimisation and Observability
stages.purpose: Turn hardware inspection and telemetry into safe workload-specific tuning.
stages.successCriteria: Memory planning, live metrics and resource policies improve useful performance without hiding trade-offs.

stages.title: Post-v1.0 Certification and Routing
stages.purpose: Certify complete model/runtime/profile identities and route only between validated configurations.
stages.successCriteria: Tool use, long context, speculative decoding and fallback decisions are measurable and side-effect aware.
